name: Open Knowledge Format
description: Author, maintain, validate, visualise, and serve Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) vaults — directories of plain Markdown + YAML frontmatter where links are graph edges.

tested_contexts: Claude Code CLI on macOS, invoking the bundled scripts through Bash
Python 3.12 and 3.14, standard library only, no third-party dependencies
184 stdlib unittest cases covering the graph model, validator exit codes, map token budget, MCP wire protocol, and viewer payload contract
Single-vault repositories where the vault is a directory of Markdown files committed alongside project code
boundaries: Not tested in Cowork or any headless environment without a local Python 3 interpreter
The MCP server is registered through the Claude Code plugin loader via .mcp.json, so it does not activate when this component is installed as a bare skill directory
Not tested on vaults maintained concurrently by Obsidian plugins or other tools writing frontmatter
Not tested on vaults larger than a few hundred notes, where the graph viewer layout and map token budget are unmeasured

artefacts: Vault notes created or edited by the skill, reviewed as ordinary Write/Edit diffs
The validator report before acting on its warnings
